research_object: Nuclear genome size (1C value) across phylogenetically structured eukaryotic lineages, initially emphasizing land plants.
invariants: Represent DNA gain and DNA loss separately.
Treat WGD as a dated event, not a final-size proxy.
Keep repeat family, annotation quality, and sampling scope explicit.
Separate mechanism evidence from causal trait interpretation.
Return an abstention state when metadata or transferability is inadequate.
eligible_seed_directions: Repeat-family turnover atlas with assembly-quality gates.
Post-WGD trajectory analysis contrasting compact and expanded relatives.
Trait-constraint analysis with explicit causal alternatives.
